description: How 2 companies or banks are connected: the shortest chain of links between 2 entities of Atlas, in either direction, and the counterparties that they share (the banks that lend to both, the customers of both, a common owner), each link with its summary, evidence and document ids. The explanation states the answer in sentences to quote, the same as the Connections view of the page: the chain step by step, the shared counterparties and, where no chain joins them, what the map contains of each and why. Where both entities belong to one group, or the kinds asked join them by no chain, the explanation gives the chain of the setting that does. By default an entity of a covered group stands as its group, so that 2 banks of one group count as one lender.

from.description: entity id from search_entities, for example boeing

group.description: draw an entity of a covered group as its group (default true)

kinds.description: kinds of link to follow (default every kind)

max_links.description: longest chain to look for (default 5, as on the page)

to.description: entity id from search_entities, for example caterpillar

name: find_connections
title: Find the connections of 2 entities
